response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005

assumptions.assumption: Net fee rate is computed per record as feerate - rebrate, and rows where it is NULL (missing feerate) are ignored by AVG. Only rows with rebrate > 0.0005 are included.

alternatives.interpretation: Average net fee rate computed only over rows where both feerate and rebrate are present and rebtotal is non-null, so both aggregates use the same set of rows
alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005 AND feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebtotal IS NOT NULL
